title: LLM能否内省？一次现实检验
summary: 本文质疑LLM能内省自身内部状态的说法。基于人类元认知研究，指出当前行为证据不足以证明内省，可能只是模式匹配。通过重新检验两个评估范式，发现模型无法可靠区分内部状态干预与输入异常，且仅访问输入的分类器能达到与模型内省预测相当的性能。结论是现有证据不足以证明LLM具有元认知监控能力。
summary_en: This paper questions claims that LLMs can introspect their internal states. Drawing on human metacognition research, it argues behavioral evidence is insufficient and may reflect pattern matching. Re-examining two evaluation paradigms, it finds models cannot reliably distinguish internal state interventions from input anomalies, and input-only classifiers match model introspective predictions. Concludes current evidence fails to demonstrate LLM metacognitive monitoring.
